description: Cumulative demand/source contributions only grow within an epoch as upstream evidence ascends; a key transiently absent from a non-rebased rerun is not a retraction. Route non-rebased conclude_return_demand_contributions and conclude_input_source_contributions through conclude_preserving_frontier; keep the rebased ground-shift path on the withdrawing conclude (preserves redefinition/minimal-recalc). Mirrors the existing AnalyzeActivation activation-input pattern. Sound, regression-free; tightens monotonicity but does not by itself close the enum_take_drop_split runaway (see the reseal-runaway arc).
title: Compiler2 fact engine: return-demand and input-source conclusions honor within-epoch monotonicity (non-rebased absence is not retraction)
